elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Garman, at Sparkling's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Subclause (i) expressly provides assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Subclause (i) expressly applies Garman's then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subclause (ii) requires Garman to return all Sparkling data in its possession or control to Sparkling.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days.
elements.evidence: Subclause (ii) requires return within thirty (30) calendar days.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: Subclause (iii) requires Garman thereafter to delete all such data from its systems.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify the deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subclause (iii) requires Garman to certify deletion to Sparkling in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Garman, at Sparkling's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six (6) months, which encompasses the ninety-day fallback period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Subclause (ii) requires Garman to return all Sparkling data in its possession or control to Sparkling.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported or returned within thirty (30) days.
elements.evidence: Subclause (ii) requires return within thirty (30) calendar days.

result.reason: The operative clause fully satisfies both the preferred and fallback positions, with correct triggers, durations, rates, data-return timing and format, and post-return deletion certification. It is not strictly minimal because it extends the return and deletion obligations beyond Customer Data to all Sparkling Confidential Information. It otherwise preserves the stated commercial intent without an evident contradiction. Drafting quality is low because the transition obligation is qualified as merely “reasonable,” deletion and certification have no specific completion deadline beyond “thereafter,” and the unconditional deletion requirement contains no legal-retention or archival-backup exception.
